name.zh: 把同级物件合成更高一级
name.en: Merge matching items into the next tier

summary.zh: 合并既带来升级，也把多个占位缩成一个。
summary.en: Merging upgrades an item while compressing several occupied cells into one.

rules.zh: 玩家把足够数量的同级物件聚在一起，消耗它们生成更高一级物件。升级产物继续占据棋盘，并能参与下一层合并；玩家要为当前素材、未来产物和暂时无法合并的零散物件分配空间。
rules.en: Gather enough matching items of the same tier and consume them to create a higher-tier item. The result stays on the board and can enter the next merge. Space must be shared among ingredients, future outputs and temporarily unmatched pieces.

loop.zh: 围绕产物准备下一组合
loop.en: Prepare the next group around the result

decisions.zh: 马上合并腾空间，还是多等几个素材争取更好的批量收益？
decisions.en: Merge now to free space or wait for more ingredients and a better batch yield?

decisions.zh: 把产物留在中央方便下一次合并，还是放边缘减少挡路？
decisions.en: Keep the result central for another merge or near an edge to reduce obstruction?

effect.zh: 需要更多素材会增加占位压力，也让腾出空间的瞬间更明显。
effect.en: More inputs increase storage pressure and the amount of space released by a merge.

effect.zh: 批量奖励鼓励等待，但过大时会让小规模合并失去价值。
effect.en: Batch bonuses reward waiting, but excessive bonuses make small merges feel pointless.

implementation.zh: 把三个以上同类物件合为更高一级：草变灌木、灌木变树；升级后的物件继续参与城市布局。
implementation.en: Merge at least three matching pieces into the next tier, such as grass into bushes and bushes into trees; upgraded pieces remain part of the spatial layout.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：城镇盘面上分布着草、树木、建筑与熊，旁边显示待用物品。
observation.en: System reference: Grass, trees, buildings and bears occupy the town board beside the available items. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: 三个同类物件可合成一个更高一级物件，五个一起合成可得到两个产物，形成等批量与腾空间的取舍。
implementation.en: Three matching items produce one higher-tier item, while five produce two, creating a trade-off between waiting for a batch and clearing space.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：岛屿格子、物品、迷雾区域与资源栏同屏显示。
observation.en: System reference: Island tiles, items, fog-covered areas and resources share the screen. See the linked text source for the rules.

contrast.zh: Triple Town把合并位置和不断填满的城镇绑在一起；Merge Dragons明确用五合二奖励较大的批量。
contrast.en: Triple Town couples merge placement to an increasingly occupied town; Merge Dragons explicitly rewards a larger batch with five-to-two conversion.

combination.zh: 组合提案：三株成熟作物可合成一株多年生作物，但等待成熟期间都占田地。玩家要比较短期收割收入与长期节省的种植空间。
combination.en: Design proposal: merge three mature crops into one perennial, while all ingredients occupy farmland as they grow. Compare immediate harvest income with long-term space savings.

setup.zh: 棋盘只剩两个空格，已有四株同级幼苗。
setup.en: Only two cells remain empty, and four same-tier seedlings are already stored.

action.zh: 玩家先把其中三株合成一株树苗。
action.en: The player merges three seedlings into one sapling.

result.zh: 损失等待五合二的机会，但立刻多出两个空格。
result.en: The player gives up a five-item batch opportunity but immediately frees two cells.

next.zh: 腾出的空间能接收新素材，再决定是否保存到下一批。
next.en: The freed cells accept new ingredients, allowing another choice about saving for a batch.

firstStep.zh: 做四乘四棋盘、三个物件等级和固定的三合一规则。
firstStep.en: Build a four-by-four board with three item tiers and a fixed three-to-one rule.

pitfall.zh: 不要一开始就加入几十条升级链；先验证空间压力是否足以形成选择。
pitfall.en: Do not start with dozens of merge chains; first test whether space pressure creates meaningful choices.

test.zh: 玩家是否能说出自己这次合并主要为了升级，还是为了腾位置？
test.en: Can players say whether a merge was primarily for an upgrade or for space?
